$comment: One entry of guide_words.json: plain words for a kind of work and the guides that hold it. The connect text gets one line per entry; guide_read with an unknown topic matches these words (agentlink/guideidx.py).

work.description: The kind of work in common words, as the connect line says it.

guides.description: The guides that hold it, in reading order. A guide that is not here is left out of the line.

words.description: Words a reader may give as a guide's topic for this work (compared in lower case, without spaces, - or _).
